73d39f282a043718.displayText: Auld Rab worked beside ye thirty years, and now he's dying, and he grips yer hand like a man gripping a ledge. Two things he leaves ye, and breath for one sentence: the great work o' his life, half-done where he left it — and the apprentice lad, half-taught at the door. “See it finished,” he says. And then he says nothing, ever again. Ye cannae do both well. Choose.
73d39f282a043718.speechText: Auld Rab worked beside ye thirty years, and now he's dying, and he grips yer hand like a man gripping a ledge. Two things he leaves ye, and breath for one sentence: the great work o' his life, half-done where he left it — and the apprentice lad, half-taught at the door. “See it finished,” he says. And then he says nothing, ever again. Ye cannae do both well. Choose.

c2f0030c3b36b01f.displayText: Two of them stand before ye, and ye are the one they've asked to judge. The maker, arms crossed, beside the thing he made — and by every measure ye ken, it is TRUE. Sound, exact, honest work; ye've checked it twice. And beside him the man it was made for, who paid for it, wearing the face of a man at a funeral. It does not suit him. It never will. Both of them are right, and the room is waiting on yer mouth.
c2f0030c3b36b01f.speechText: Two of them stand before ye, and ye are the one they've asked to judge. The maker, arms crossed, beside the thing he made — and by every measure ye ken, it is TRUE. Sound, exact, honest work; ye've checked it twice. And beside him the man it was made for, who paid for it, wearing the face of a man at a funeral. It does not suit him. It never will. Both of them are right, and the room is waiting on yer mouth.

6824f0d43a7a1f31.displayText: The river's in yer stairwell — came up in the night like a thief, and it's still rising. One armful, nae more, and the rest is the water's. In yer room: the tin box wi' every penny ye have. The papers that prove what ye own and what ye're owed. Yer mother's letters, that exist nowhere else on this earth. And through the wall, the neighbour's bairn, crying in the dark — whether the neighbour's in there wi' her, or away, or has her in her arms already on the far stair, the wall willnae tell ye. One minute. One armful. Choose.
6824f0d43a7a1f31.speechText: The river's in yer stairwell — came up in the night like a thief, and it's still rising. One armful, nae more, and the rest is the water's. In yer room: the tin box wi' every penny ye have. The papers that prove what ye own and what ye're owed. Yer mother's letters, that exist nowhere else on this earth. And through the wall, the neighbour's bairn, crying in the dark — whether the neighbour's in there wi' her, or away, or has her in her arms already on the far stair, the wall willnae tell ye. One minute. One armful. Choose.

cde75c156aa2a1ca.displayText: At the end of a long wake, when the room has thinned to embers, a man ye hardly ken sits down beside ye and tells ye a thing that cannae be untold. A wrong he did, years back, to a man ye break bread wi' every week — never found out, and never mended. He asks ye for nothing. That's the trap of it. Tomorrow he'll walk the town as ever, and only ye will ken.
cde75c156aa2a1ca.speechText: At the end of a long wake, when the room has thinned to embers, a man ye hardly ken sits down beside ye and tells ye a thing that cannae be untold. A wrong he did, years back, to a man ye break bread wi' every week — never found out, and never mended. He asks ye for nothing. That's the trap of it. Tomorrow he'll walk the town as ever, and only ye will ken.

084efce5e37e8980.displayText: A hard winter, and yer debts stand at the door like dogs. Then a letter: paid. All of it. Nae name, nae condition — only a line in a strange hand: “For a kindness ye'll no' remember.” Ye search yer memory and find nothing there. It is more than ye needed and far more than ye earned, and whoever did it doesnae want finding.
084efce5e37e8980.speechText: A hard winter, and yer debts stand at the door like dogs. Then a letter: paid. All of it. Nae name, nae condition — only a line in a strange hand: “For a kindness ye'll no' remember.” Ye search yer memory and find nothing there. It is more than ye needed and far more than ye earned, and whoever did it doesnae want finding.

61738e31674a705c.displayText: The biggest order o' yer year, bound for buyers across the sea who will never once stand in yer doorway. There is a cheaper way to do it — no' wrong, exactly; thinner. And yer own voice, quite reasonably, says: thinner is all they asked for and all they paid for — nae buyer on that shore could tell the difference, nor want to. Three winters till it shows, and by then there's an ocean between ye. And the wee ones have slept two winters now under the rain-stain. Ye have till the tide.
61738e31674a705c.speechText: The biggest order o' yer year, bound for buyers across the sea who will never once stand in yer doorway. There is a cheaper way to do it — no' wrong, exactly; thinner. And yer own voice, quite reasonably, says: thinner is all they asked for and all they paid for — nae buyer on that shore could tell the difference, nor want to. Three winters till it shows, and by then there's an ocean between ye. And the wee ones have slept two winters now under the rain-stain. Ye have till the tide.

fd491a05c1036204.displayText: He is no' a wicked man — that's the devil of it. The landlord's new factor, the man who collects the rents, offers ye a settled rent, a warm back door, first call on every good thing — and asks only that when the vote comes, yer hand rises where his does. He points out the window at the hungry doorways and the cold stairs. “Order feeds more folk than principle ever did,” he says. And looking where he points, ye cannae call him wrong.
fd491a05c1036204.speechText: He is no' a wicked man — that's the devil of it. The landlord's new factor, the man who collects the rents, offers ye a settled rent, a warm back door, first call on every good thing — and asks only that when the vote comes, yer hand rises where his does. He points out the window at the hungry doorways and the cold stairs. “Order feeds more folk than principle ever did,” he says. And looking where he points, ye cannae call him wrong.

dec21fedbc2d8b66.displayText: They've caught a man at the thing ye've only ever thought about in the low hours — the shortcut ye never took, the leaving ye never did. And as they bring him past, he stops, and smiles, and says, low: “You and me — berries off the same field.” The worst of it is no' that he's lying. Yer word tomorrow helps sink him or save him.
dec21fedbc2d8b66.speechText: They've caught a man at the thing ye've only ever thought about in the low hours — the shortcut ye never took, the leaving ye never did. And as they bring him past, he stops, and smiles, and says, low: “You and me — berries off the same field.” The worst of it is no' that he's lying. Yer word tomorrow helps sink him or save him.

300d316c3e8c30ff.displayText: A feast night, the long table full, when a letter that should never have left its drawer is read aloud for sport — and the man it undresses is sitting right there, gone the colour of ash. The room goes quiet the way a room does when it has been given a body to eat. Ye have the space of a breath, and where ye stand in it will be remembered as long as anybody at this table lives.
300d316c3e8c30ff.speechText: A feast night, the long table full, when a letter that should never have left its drawer is read aloud for sport — and the man it undresses is sitting right there, gone the colour of ash. The room goes quiet the way a room does when it has been given a body to eat. Ye have the space of a breath, and where ye stand in it will be remembered as long as anybody at this table lives.

523f5554c5d3ac86.displayText: He has broken his word twice — once to the whole street, and once, more privately, to you. Now he stands at yer door asking ye to stand caution for him before the court: yer name under his, yer money behind his promise. The record says no. Something in ye, looking at him, says maybe. Nobody else will do it — and refusing is safe, sensible, and blameless.
523f5554c5d3ac86.speechText: He has broken his word twice — once to the whole street, and once, more privately, to you. Now he stands at yer door asking ye to stand caution for him before the court: yer name under his, yer money behind his promise. The record says no. Something in ye, looking at him, says maybe. Nobody else will do it — and refusing is safe, sensible, and blameless.

71b948897af61cc4.displayText: Once, years back, ye did a wee kindness — hardly worth the word. A bowl. A bed for a night. A lie no' told. Now the man ye did it for is rich, and he stands in the middle of the town telling everybody that wee thing SAVED him — and he wants to pay it back a thousandfold, wi' yer name over the door of the paying. A bairn ye're raising is watching how ye answer.
71b948897af61cc4.speechText: Once, years back, ye did a wee kindness — hardly worth the word. A bowl. A bed for a night. A lie no' told. Now the man ye did it for is rich, and he stands in the middle of the town telling everybody that wee thing SAVED him — and he wants to pay it back a thousandfold, wi' yer name over the door of the paying. A bairn ye're raising is watching how ye answer.

59af8558a71ef435.displayText: The auld man's chair — his grandmother's before him — comes to ye wi' the house, worn to the shape of four generations of sitting. The joints are going. The family looks to ye, as the one they trust wi' such things, to say what's done wi' it. Every one of them wants a different right thing.
59af8558a71ef435.speechText: The auld man's chair — his grandmother's before him — comes to ye wi' the house, worn to the shape of four generations of sitting. The joints are going. The family looks to ye, as the one they trust wi' such things, to say what's done wi' it. Every one of them wants a different right thing.

e378d0ac06276b73.displayText: You go at the thing nobody else will touch, and you cannot leave it while it is still wrong. Their searchers smashed bad work on the Saturday and paid a widow’s rent out of the Gill Stoup on the Sunday, and saw no contradiction in it. Neither do you. Mind the pressure, though: not everything yields to it, and some people are not problems to be solved.
e378d0ac06276b73.speechText: You go at the thing nobody else will touch, and you cannot leave it while it is still wrong. Their searchers smashed bad work on the Saturday and paid a widow’s rent out of the Gill Stoup on the Sunday, and saw no contradiction in it. Neither do you. Mind the pressure, though: not everything yields to it, and some people are not problems to be solved.

4a9fef6db685d8b0.displayText: You join things. Timber, plans, folk who had stopped speaking to each other. Their word for a man who never made his essay was pendicle, and they meant it as the worst thing you could call somebody, because proof was not paperwork to them but the whole of a man’s standing. You will finish what you started or it will nag at you for years.
4a9fef6db685d8b0.speechText: You join things. Timber, plans, folk who had stopped speaking to each other. Their word for a man who never made his essay was pendicle, and they meant it as the worst thing you could call somebody, because proof was not paperwork to them but the whole of a man’s standing. You will finish what you started or it will nag at you for years.

d146b063f8d47d4d.displayText: You build for people you will never meet. When the town said his arch would fall, Mungo Naismith slept the night under it, because argument is cheap and a night is not. That is your instinct exactly. The risk is mistaking permanence for rightness, and refusing to shift a thing that ought to shift.
d146b063f8d47d4d.speechText: You build for people you will never meet. When the town said his arch would fall, Mungo Naismith slept the night under it, because argument is cheap and a night is not. That is your instinct exactly. The risk is mistaking permanence for rightness, and refusing to shift a thing that ought to shift.

521b3bf4a825215d.displayText: You are the one trusted with what must not leak. A barrel is thirty separate staves that hold only because they are bound, and the whole trade came down to one merciless question every Saturday morning: does it hold? You ask it of yourself first. Slacken the hoop now and then. Not everything precious wants gripping.
521b3bf4a825215d.speechText: You are the one trusted with what must not leak. A barrel is thirty separate staves that hold only because they are bound, and the whole trade came down to one merciless question every Saturday morning: does it hold? You ask it of yourself first. Slacken the hoop now and then. Not everything precious wants gripping.

2d3b913b0b008c2b.displayText: You see the crooked seam before anybody says a word. They kept a locked room where a man proved himself alone, and in 1724 they unseated their own Deacon over eleven unpaid pennies, because a rule that bends for the powerful is decoration. Fit is your religion. Some things have to breathe before they are finished.
2d3b913b0b008c2b.speechText: You see the crooked seam before anybody says a word. They kept a locked room where a man proved himself alone, and in 1724 they unseated their own Deacon over eleven unpaid pennies, because a rule that bends for the powerful is decoration. Fit is your religion. Some things have to breathe before they are finished.

889be07a3e21daaa.displayText: You notice how the threads run. Their deacons served one year only, written down as being for the avoiding of all superioritie and tyrannie, and in 1615 they ruled that a master who withheld his knowledge from an apprentice had committed theft. That is your politics, whether or not you have ever said it aloud. You will carry loose ends that were never yours to carry.
889be07a3e21daaa.speechText: You notice how the threads run. Their deacons served one year only, written down as being for the avoiding of all superioritie and tyrannie, and in 1615 they ruled that a master who withheld his knowledge from an apprentice had committed theft. That is your politics, whether or not you have ever said it aloud. You will carry loose ends that were never yours to carry.

6f64927901ec4b1f.displayText: You make the thing by which people are known. They knitted the blue bonnet out of waste wool until it was the badge of a whole country, then took in the dyers for one reason: a colour that fades is a small public lie. You would rather be true than fashionable. You would also rather change than die, and this craft has done exactly that twice.
6f64927901ec4b1f.speechText: You make the thing by which people are known. They knitted the blue bonnet out of waste wool until it was the badge of a whole country, then took in the dyers for one reason: a colour that fades is a small public lie. You would rather be true than fashionable. You would also rather change than die, and this craft has done exactly that twice.

0318d1e804ed438b.displayText: You take what the world discards and make it worth keeping. Their founding charter has the two trades agreeing to unyte ourself in cherite togidder, and they hold the oldest charter of the fourteen while standing seventh in the line, and have never once made a fuss about it. You will outlast a good many people who talked more.
0318d1e804ed438b.speechText: You take what the world discards and make it worth keeping. Their founding charter has the two trades agreeing to unyte ourself in cherite togidder, and they hold the oldest charter of the fourteen while standing seventh in the line, and have never once made a fuss about it. You will outlast a good many people who talked more.

abe5783a26121580.displayText: A shoemaker’s son is a Prince born. That was theirs, and they meant it: they crowned their own King Crispin and paraded him through Glasgow while actual kings went about looking shabby. The same craft made six thousand pairs of shoes for an army that was not theirs, because feet are feet. Careful the crown does not become the point of it.
abe5783a26121580.speechText: A shoemaker’s son is a Prince born. That was theirs, and they meant it: they crowned their own King Crispin and paraded him through Glasgow while actual kings went about looking shabby. The same craft made six thousand pairs of shoes for an army that was not theirs, because feet are feet. Careful the crown does not become the point of it.

033c866ae6f60fd6.displayText: The town must eat, today, at an honest weight. They went to prison rather than sign on the magistrates’ terms, and once fed an army the night before the battle that settled a kingdom. You feed people and you make no performance of it. Watch the shadow: the baker they punished was the one selling full loaves too cheaply.
033c866ae6f60fd6.speechText: The town must eat, today, at an honest weight. They went to prison rather than sign on the magistrates’ terms, and once fed an army the night before the battle that settled a kingdom. You feed people and you make no performance of it. Watch the shadow: the baker they punished was the one selling full loaves too cheaply.

636f2457064abc81.displayText: You have the strong stomach that lets everybody else keep clean hands. Their signature fraud had a name of its own, the blawing of muttoun, and the man who could spot it was the same man who could have done it. They beat the magistrates in court in 1802 and never once rioted. Keep a calm sough. Just do not let steady harden into unmoved.
636f2457064abc81.speechText: You have the strong stomach that lets everybody else keep clean hands. Their signature fraud had a name of its own, the blawing of muttoun, and the man who could spot it was the same man who could have done it. They beat the magistrates in court in 1802 and never once rioted. Keep a calm sough. Just do not let steady harden into unmoved.

9267a289b5ce88a9.displayText: You are patient with what cannot be hurried. Twice Parliament declared them no craft at all; twice they quietly renamed their chief and bought their liberty back, and four and a half centuries on they are still led by a Visitor rather than a Deacon. There is a wall around your care, though, and it is worth asking now and then who is standing outside it.
9267a289b5ce88a9.speechText: You are patient with what cannot be hurried. Twice Parliament declared them no craft at all; twice they quietly renamed their chief and bought their liberty back, and four and a half centuries on they are still led by a Visitor rather than a Deacon. There is a wall around your care, though, and it is worth asking now and then who is standing outside it.

37a8330c427012bf.displayText: Yours is the only craft whose arms show the moment everything went wrong, Adam and Eve and the serpent and the tree, and they read that not as a curse but as a claim: the one trade practised before the Fall. The moon on their shield is waxing. You plant for eyes that will not be yours. Not everything wants tending; some of it wants pruning.
37a8330c427012bf.speechText: Yours is the only craft whose arms show the moment everything went wrong, Adam and Eve and the serpent and the tree, and they read that not as a curse but as a claim: the one trade practised before the Fall. The moon on their shield is waxing. You plant for eyes that will not be yours. Not everything wants tending; some of it wants pruning.

f8ae1d5e7cd9b0f8.displayText: Every morning half a city bared its throat to a man holding a razor, and then talked. That is what you are for. Locked out of their own hall, they went to the kirk and took the minutes anyway and won by sheer patience; they booked Black journeymen in 1741, women in 1791, and petitioned against the slave trade in 1792. You are trusted with what people say when they relax, which is also the danger.
f8ae1d5e7cd9b0f8.speechText: Every morning half a city bared its throat to a man holding a razor, and then talked. That is what you are for. Locked out of their own hall, they went to the kirk and took the minutes anyway and won by sheer patience; they booked Black journeymen in 1741, women in 1791, and petitioned against the slave trade in 1792. You are trusted with what people say when they relax, which is also the danger.

ec42b9a196251651.displayText: Ten years, ye say. And ye never blinked at the number. Rab knew what he was doing, handing that to you.
ec42b9a196251651.speechText: Ten years, ye say. And ye never blinked at the number. Rab knew what he was doing, handing that to you.

c17530bbaa3062b2.displayText: The lad, then. In thirty years somebody will ask whose work it is, and there'll be nae simple answer.
c17530bbaa3062b2.speechText: The lad, then. In thirty years somebody will ask whose work it is, and there'll be nae simple answer.

520e6aa4eae8feb1.displayText: The widow eats. Nobody carves that on a wall, but she eats.
520e6aa4eae8feb1.speechText: The widow eats. Nobody carves that on a wall, but she eats.

d119f1266cba47b8.displayText: Untouched. Some would call that giving up, some the only honest thing left. You ken which ye meant.
d119f1266cba47b8.speechText: Untouched. Some would call that giving up, some the only honest thing left. You ken which ye meant.

1305a514b91f1b69.displayText: The measure holds. And a man walks home with a true thing he will never love. Both of those are yours now.
1305a514b91f1b69.speechText: The measure holds. And a man walks home with a true thing he will never love. Both of those are yours now.

d985a6aff4a7f8c1.displayText: The fit wins. He'll no' forget it — a maker remembers the day his true work was sent back.
d985a6aff4a7f8c1.speechText: The fit wins. He'll no' forget it — a maker remembers the day his true work was sent back.

eaab3fa9c2381800.displayText: Locked in together. Och, ye brave soul. I've seen that end in a handshake and I've seen it end worse.
eaab3fa9c2381800.speechText: Locked in together. Och, ye brave soul. I've seen that end in a handshake and I've seen it end worse.

4be1bed6e37d4ee1.displayText: Ye paid. The cheapest way out of that room was a word, and ye chose the dearest.
4be1bed6e37d4ee1.speechText: Ye paid. The cheapest way out of that room was a word, and ye chose the dearest.

3ba95960d11f2106.displayText: The box. Cold arithmetic in a warm panic — that takes a certain nerve.
3ba95960d11f2106.speechText: The box. Cold arithmetic in a warm panic — that takes a certain nerve.

113b639be14b9f5f.displayText: The papers. A year from now the claim is won and nobody thanks ye for it. You'll ken, though.
113b639be14b9f5f.speechText: The papers. A year from now the claim is won and nobody thanks ye for it. You'll ken, though.

c9460a7cdf82b42c.displayText: Her hand on the paper. Poorer, and holding the only copy that ever existed.
c9460a7cdf82b42c.speechText: Her hand on the paper. Poorer, and holding the only copy that ever existed.

3294e799e005892c.displayText: Through the wall. Ye never waited to find out if she needed ye. That is the whole of ye, that.
3294e799e005892c.speechText: Through the wall. Ye never waited to find out if she needed ye. That is the whole of ye, that.

0e0122ec6eb1aba8.displayText: A deadline. The man came for peace and left with a week. Mercy with teeth in it.
0e0122ec6eb1aba8.speechText: A deadline. The man came for peace and left with a week. Mercy with teeth in it.

7ee5f32d8c0b65e9.displayText: Ye'll mend it quiet and let him keep the comfort of being unpunished. A strange, generous arithmetic.
7ee5f32d8c0b65e9.speechText: Ye'll mend it quiet and let him keep the comfort of being unpunished. A strange, generous arithmetic.

f569bf427632d762.displayText: In yer pocket, then. Mind — a thing kept that long starts to feel like it belongs to ye.
f569bf427632d762.speechText: In yer pocket, then. Mind — a thing kept that long starts to feel like it belongs to ye.

cf25b23d33f72d43.displayText: Ye carried it. Two tables, one man, nae relief in either seat.
cf25b23d33f72d43.speechText: Ye carried it. Two tables, one man, nae relief in either seat.

9c05d3d7d9551d41.displayText: Ye let yerself be helped. You would be astonished how many cannae, and call it pride.
9c05d3d7d9551d41.speechText: Ye let yerself be helped. You would be astonished how many cannae, and call it pride.

8bb78705d84433e0.displayText: Squared to the penny. Grace, filed under settled. It'll sleep better in the ledger.
8bb78705d84433e0.speechText: Squared to the penny. Grace, filed under settled. It'll sleep better in the ledger.

740b712132e43e83.displayText: Passed on into the dark. Somebody gets a good winter and never learns whose.
740b712132e43e83.speechText: Passed on into the dark. Somebody gets a good winter and never learns whose.

e339bfb9cb903d9c.displayText: Banked against the hook. I would want ye counting my money. I'm no' sure I'd want yer winter.
e339bfb9cb903d9c.speechText: Banked against the hook. I would want ye counting my money. I'm no' sure I'd want yer winter.

06ef43d212f54742.displayText: True, and the roof waits. Yer wee ones will no' understand that for twenty years. Then they will.
06ef43d212f54742.speechText: True, and the roof waits. Yer wee ones will no' understand that for twenty years. Then they will.

732158fd974b303b.displayText: Written into the bargain. Every man after ye is bound by a rule he never agreed to — that is how a standard starts, and why it's hated.
732158fd974b303b.speechText: Written into the bargain. Every man after ye is bound by a rule he never agreed to — that is how a standard starts, and why it's hated.

286ed1ebc018d4b6.displayText: Thin where it doesnae show. You'll keep that ledger in yer head, and it is a heavy one.
286ed1ebc018d4b6.speechText: Thin where it doesnae show. You'll keep that ledger in yer head, and it is a heavy one.

40a352f363b77044.displayText: Turned down flat. The best purse of the year, refused on a principle nobody asked ye to hold.
40a352f363b77044.speechText: Turned down flat. The best purse of the year, refused on a principle nobody asked ye to hold.

cdeb324c0faba876.displayText: Ye took it, and ye meant it. Warm houses. And every vote from here is his — ye knew that when ye said aye.
cdeb324c0faba876.speechText: Ye took it, and ye meant it. Warm houses. And every vote from here is his — ye knew that when ye said aye.

89743d5fb4b53502.displayText: At the market cross, out loud. Ye've made yerself expensive to ignore and cheap to punish.
89743d5fb4b53502.speechText: At the market cross, out loud. Ye've made yerself expensive to ignore and cheap to punish.

b7a443cd7a323c98.displayText: Quiet, every time. Nae banner, nae credit, nae witness. That one is only ever between you and you.
b7a443cd7a323c98.speechText: Quiet, every time. Nae banner, nae credit, nae witness. That one is only ever between you and you.

cd500c50eefe0796.displayText: His coin, yer purpose. Every man who took that road told himself the same. Some were even right.
cd500c50eefe0796.speechText: His coin, yer purpose. Every man who took that road told himself the same. Some were even right.

837066c7e38b5cd2.displayText: Condemned whole, and ye took the cut yerself. An expensive kind of honesty.
837066c7e38b5cd2.speechText: Condemned whole, and ye took the cut yerself. An expensive kind of honesty.

ccff1c0b1b08c828.displayText: Ye stood for him. This town has a long memory and a short list of folk it forgives for that.
ccff1c0b1b08c828.speechText: Ye stood for him. This town has a long memory and a short list of folk it forgives for that.

16cb8d97fd8ff165.displayText: Nothing either way. He meets it alone, and you go home and look at the field. Both true.
16cb8d97fd8ff165.speechText: Nothing either way. He meets it alone, and you go home and look at the field. Both true.

113a74cd8b891b68.displayText: Said it out loud in a court, then put yer name on his mending. That's no' mercy, that's an investment.
113a74cd8b891b68.speechText: Said it out loud in a court, then put yer name on his mending. That's no' mercy, that's an investment.

849344f68328bea9.displayText: Ye sat down beside him and ate. Nothing said. The whole room read it anyway.
849344f68328bea9.speechText: Ye sat down beside him and ate. Nothing said. The whole room read it anyway.

f235c68e34585ba3.displayText: On yer feet, order restored. The man is still the colour of ash, mind — but the feast survived.
f235c68e34585ba3.speechText: On yer feet, order restored. The man is still the colour of ash, mind — but the feast survived.

0fc5737be86562a2.displayText: Ye named the reader. An enemy with friends, and a friend with none.
0fc5737be86562a2.speechText: Ye named the reader. An enemy with friends, and a friend with none.

2a39624fbdcfa728.displayText: Ye kicked over yer own glass. The daftest, kindest thing in that room, and nobody will ever ken it was deliberate.
2a39624fbdcfa728.speechText: Ye kicked over yer own glass. The daftest, kindest thing in that room, and nobody will ever ken it was deliberate.

301874b6bf3d1186.displayText: The whole caution. Twice broken, and ye signed. That is faith, or arithmetic ye've no' done.
301874b6bf3d1186.speechText: The whole caution. Twice broken, and ye signed. That is faith, or arithmetic ye've no' done.

131507b8649a4981.displayText: Half, with the truth attached. You'll find out soon enough whether a man can hear that as anything but an insult.
131507b8649a4981.speechText: Half, with the truth attached. You'll find out soon enough whether a man can hear that as anything but an insult.

7b0e809b07728574.displayText: Ye walked beside him and signed nothing. He'll mind the walking. He'll mind the nothing too.
7b0e809b07728574.speechText: Ye walked beside him and signed nothing. He'll mind the walking. He'll mind the nothing too.

fcf406ce012d25b8.displayText: Refused plainly, with a reason. If he sinks, he hears that sentence in your voice for the rest of his life.
fcf406ce012d25b8.speechText: Refused plainly, with a reason. If he sinks, he hears that sentence in your voice for the rest of his life.

29e4a8a75fe191dc.displayText: Handed back, and him set to work. He keeps it or he doesnae, and you'll ken by the spring.
29e4a8a75fe191dc.speechText: Handed back, and him set to work. He keeps it or he doesnae, and you'll ken by the spring.

d2b77c5f256215ad.displayText: Ye built the machine. A thousand bowls a year and no' a warm word in any of them — and it is a real thing ye've made.
d2b77c5f256215ad.speechText: Ye built the machine. A thousand bowls a year and no' a warm word in any of them — and it is a real thing ye've made.

e906713b17125cf3.displayText: Ye let him have his stage. The town gets a spectacle and you get a part ye never auditioned for.
e906713b17125cf3.speechText: Ye let him have his stage. The town gets a spectacle and you get a part ye never auditioned for.

6d058ef19995d80d.displayText: Ye told the bairn the true part and let him tell the rest. Two stories now, and only one of them yours.
6d058ef19995d80d.speechText: Ye told the bairn the true part and let him tell the rest. Two stories now, and only one of them yours.

a587f8bd2f64c22e.displayText: Mended for sitting. Every repair takes a wee bit of the auld hands away, and ye did it anyway.
a587f8bd2f64c22e.speechText: Mended for sitting. Every repair takes a wee bit of the auld hands away, and ye did it anyway.

2f63dfc9046556b2.displayText: Sealed and set apart. It'll outlive every one of them now, and never hold another soul.
2f63dfc9046556b2.speechText: Sealed and set apart. It'll outlive every one of them now, and never hold another soul.

30a79d375f7eec5b.displayText: Sold, and the roof fixed. The oldest thing in that family left in a cart, and the living stayed dry.
30a79d375f7eec5b.speechText: Sold, and the roof fixed. The oldest thing in that family left in a cart, and the living stayed dry.

ec3b14b05d885387.displayText: The chair and the mending both. Her first repair will be poor and it will show forever. That's the point, is it no'?
ec3b14b05d885387.speechText: The chair and the mending both. Her first repair will be poor and it will show forever. That's the point, is it no'?

c9af206b6cb9b930.displayText: Hold still, now. Let me look at ye properly.
c9af206b6cb9b930.speechText: Hold still, now. Let me look at ye properly.

188fe2d7e857a7db.displayText: Mm. More than one o' them has a claim on ye. I can feel the pull o' it.
188fe2d7e857a7db.speechText: Mm. More than one o' them has a claim on ye. I can feel the pull o' it.

6e74bee4cf72ae37.displayText: Mm. The book has that now.
6e74bee4cf72ae37.speechText: Mm. The book has that now.

01a04577c0e982a3.displayText: Noted. I'll no' say what I think.
01a04577c0e982a3.speechText: Noted. I'll no' say what I think.

709d43b68be2835c.displayText: Right ye are. On we go.
709d43b68be2835c.speechText: Right ye are. On we go.

dc05e67dedb69be6.displayText: That's the ink dry on that one.
dc05e67dedb69be6.speechText: That's the ink dry on that one.

11542451e7a75255.displayText: Mm-hm. Ye didnae flinch. I'll mark that too.
11542451e7a75255.speechText: Mm-hm. Ye didnae flinch. I'll mark that too.

29f7313b5c09d107.displayText: Down it goes, in a fair hand.
29f7313b5c09d107.speechText: Down it goes, in a fair hand.

9c744e2a35c101d8.displayText: Aye. Some folk take longer at that one.
9c744e2a35c101d8.speechText: Aye. Some folk take longer at that one.

17a9c8684bbd30da.displayText: Och, that's an answer and a half. Onward.
17a9c8684bbd30da.speechText: Och, that's an answer and a half. Onward.

7edc7a2ed60a99ae.displayText: And the last of it — hold still while I write.
7edc7a2ed60a99ae.speechText: And the last of it — hold still while I write.

ff9397be6b47d9b8.displayText: Careful — the varnish is aulder than yer country.
ff9397be6b47d9b8.speechText: Careful — the varnish is aulder than yer country.

42d0281103132206.displayText: Aye, hullo. I'm a PAINTING. This is one-way glass, friend.
42d0281103132206.speechText: Aye, hullo. I'm a PAINTING. This is one-way glass, friend.

4fd0eaeacb7ebb21.displayText: Poke the Bakers' crest instead, it's softer.
4fd0eaeacb7ebb21.speechText: Poke the Bakers' crest instead, it's softer.

563842ed485c0c81.displayText: Persistent! The Hammermen tak applications, ye ken.
563842ed485c0c81.speechText: Persistent! The Hammermen tak applications, ye ken.

18d31d6ada00d809.displayText: Right. That's it. I'm telling the Deacon.
18d31d6ada00d809.speechText: Right. That's it. I'm telling the Deacon.

55947c138588bb90.displayText: …Still at it. I admire it. I HATE it — but I admire it.
55947c138588bb90.speechText: …Still at it. I admire it. I HATE it — but I admire it.

4580f187fea7847b.displayText: The frame is gold leaf. The man is priceless. HANDS.
4580f187fea7847b.speechText: The frame is gold leaf. The man is priceless. HANDS.

f52551e9ddadc60d.displayText: Tak yer time. I've nothing but.
f52551e9ddadc60d.speechText: Tak yer time. I've nothing but.

bcabc7ff7eda6e4c.displayText: The bell above us was cast in seventeen ninety-four. It waits fine, ye ken.
bcabc7ff7eda6e4c.speechText: The bell above us was cast in seventeen ninety-four. It waits fine, ye ken.

d13b18a4ef1feee0.displayText: WHA—! I wisnae sleeping. I was thinking wi' my eyes shut.
d13b18a4ef1feee0.speechText: WHA—! I wisnae sleeping. I was thinking wi' my eyes shut.
